assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production bitmap MATERIAL ATLAS for a polished 2D pixel RPG map floor. Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for classic flat 2D RPG pixel-art rendering; ignore all UI, characters, buildings and writing. Create a LANDSCAPE image in approximately 3:2 aspect ratio with EXACTLY TWO equally sized full-height rectangular material panels side by side: LEFT panel darker terrain, RIGHT panel lighter walking-surface texture. Each panel is a complete top-down flat material field covering its entire half; no separator/gutter/border. This is NOT a finished map: NO ROAD SHAPES or paths, because the engine applies these materials along real map routes. Art direction: refined hand-authored 2D pixel art, carefully placed fine 1-2 pixel clusters at native high resolution, harmonious nuanced 12-20 color palette, tasteful layered texture, surface looks natural and calm at smartphone scale, no crude enlarged square pixels and no random full-screen noise. Medium detail with broad quiet areas and small clustered details; natural color variation. Orthographic top-down completely level floor. NO 3D depth, cliffs, slope ledges, cast shadows, bevels, raised rocks, lighting gradients or perspective. No characters, creatures, trees, buildings, furniture, equipment, text, symbols, UI, logos, grid, circular stains, regular stripe patches, repeated macro-patterns. The two materials should have a clear lightness difference but rich subtle color variation within each. Left half: lush muted yellow-green and sage grass floor with natural fine grass blades in small irregular clumps, moss, subtle leaf-litter areas with restrained gold and rust leaves. Right half: light warm sandy ochre and pale cream compacted woodland earth with subtle worn grain, a few very small flat pebbles and tiny leaf specks, spacious and calm.
